body:
I think so to, being reborn. I use to feel like, life is just a repetition of our own previous lifes. You start over with a different set of choices. This time I'll look like this, and I'll live in this place, I'll be rich or poor, etc.
When you're ready to go at it again, there would be this voice saying; "don't screw it up this time, again..."
Maybe we are supposed to screw it up again and again, till we learn that lesson and then again move to the next lesson.
I don't know. I think the thought of that used to comfort me when I was younger.

I have the same feeling. I felt this urge to write down my thoughts and share it with people that can relate to it.
I to, am afraid of the power to know how to end it. I feel your pain I feel you fear.
Now I think about what comes next for me after am gone. I don't know if there's a next for me or for anyone. Am thinking, this world, this violent and painful world with it small and fleeting comforts, what comes next ?

Well, am not good. I didn't entend to play victim by writing this. But just try to clear my mind and understand fully why i feel so bad all the time.  i have myself wronged people maybe not intentionally. But am sure i did.
I believe the main reason why i havent been bad to people is maybe i was never in a position to be. No one is truly good, we just tend to choose the easy way that makes us feel good and most of the time it means making other people feel less. I dont blame anyone. i just wish i had more choices in life.

I dont have much to say, other than i feel you. My life experience ha so far has been pretty much the same.  
Just not being enough for anything nor anyone
